One workspace for the people side of the business.

What OrgVia is, who uses it, and how the pieces fit together.

What is OrgVia?

OrgVia is a web-based HRMS, or human resource management system. It is the place where an organization keeps its employee records and runs the recurring HR processes around them: attendance, leave, payroll, hiring, onboarding and performance.

It is multi-tenant: every organization works in its own separated workspace, configured and administered by that organization.

What does HRMS software do?

An HRMS replaces the patchwork of spreadsheets, forms and email threads HR teams often rely on. It stores one record per employee, applies the organization’s rules to things like leave and payroll, and lets the right people approve, review or report from the same data.

How does OrgVia help an HR department?

  • Employee profiles, employment details and documents are kept in one place.
  • The org chart is generated from reporting lines, so it does not need separate upkeep.
  • Leave requests flow to the approving manager with the policy and balance attached.
  • HR can see the whole organization while managers see their own teams.

Who uses it

  • Employees: clock in, view their own profile, apply for leave, see payslips.
  • Managers: see their team and approve requests within their reporting line.
  • Recruiters: work jobs, candidates and interviews.
  • HR: administer people, leave, payroll and performance.
  • Administrators: configure the organization and access.

Modules are switched on per organization, so what you see depends on the setup agreed with your administrator.

The org chart is part of the people record, not a separate diagram.

Start with people

Add employees individually or import from CSV, then assign departments, roles and reporting managers.

Add workflows

Turn on attendance, leave, payroll, hiring, onboarding, performance and compliance as your organization needs them.
